neighbours.label: The token ' sk' as tested in ski words (skier, skied, skis), and the Arabic ' مق' of 'مقاومة' and 'مقاضاة'; whole tokens such as ' skull', ' sketch' and ' skin', and other Arabic nouns, stay quiet.

short: ' sk' of ski words; Arabic مق-
notes: Probes: ' sk' in skier 0.43-0.89, skied 0.75, skis 0.38; ' skiing' (one token) 0.05, skin and sky about 0; Arabic 0.53-0.87, peaking on ' مق' or the next 'ا'. Other words that split into ' sk' (such as skater) would read the same at that token by construction, so this test cannot say the token is about skiing. Whether the two parts are one distinction I don't know: a list.
